no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was held for this application as there were no complex or substantive review issues.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the KLISYRI (tirbanibulin) NDA213189 review. The FDA multidisciplinary review states that no Advisory Committee meeting was held because there were no complex or substantive review issues, and no REMS program was planned. There are therefore no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
